name: 序列性能 — 缓存配置与性能优化
description: Oracle 序列 (SEQUENCE) 性能优化规则。序列缓存 (CACHE) 配置不当在高并发环境下导致 row cache lock 等待。RAC 环境中 ORDER 选项导致跨实例同步更是严重瓶颈。

root_causes.name: 序列 CACHE 值过小
root_causes.desc: 默认 CACHE = 20，高并发 INSERT 频繁用尽缓存需要访问数据字典获取新范围，导致 row cache lock。

root_causes.name: RAC 环境使用 ORDER 序列
root_causes.desc: ORDER 选项要求序列值全局有序，每次获取值需要跨实例同步，极大增加延迟。

root_causes.name: NOCACHE 序列
root_causes.desc: 使用 NOCACHE 的序列每次取值都要更新数据字典，在高并发下成为串行化瓶颈。

root_causes.name: 大量序列同时使用
root_causes.desc: 同一表的多个列使用不同序列，或应用过度使用序列做非必要编号。

step1_check_sequences.sql: SELECT sequence_name, cache_size, order_flag FROM DBA_SEQUENCES WHERE sequence_owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND cache_size < 100 ORDER BY cache_size

step2_check_row_cache.desc: 检查 row cache lock 等待
step2_check_row_cache.sql: SELECT total_waits AS rcl_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000,2) AS avg_ms FROM v$system_event WHERE event = 'row cache lock'

step3_check_ash_sequence.sql: SELECT sql_id, COUNT(*) samples FROM v$active_session_history WHERE event = 'row cache lock' AND sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR GROUP BY sql_id ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

step3_nocache_sequences.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nocache_count FROM DBA_SEQUENCES WHERE sequence_owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND cache_size = 0
